Does not assert secure native creation is always forbidden in combat.
design.profile: 5 alternating fresh-process pairs;deterministic counts;no native profiler/forced GC.Wall times include process construction/assertions and are not native operation latency. Native active settings/addon list/hardware/CPU/memory/allocations/frame time unavailable.
design.lifecycle: Removed global native mixin/pool/duration/visibility replacement and patch timers. One secure visibility posthook;one post-init style hook and seed pass per persistent native session/source window;no per-entry hooks.
